video_review.reviewer: Codex /root/scenarios/refs_workspaces; inline full PNGs, paired terminal JSON and sampled MP4 contact sheet
video_review.summary: Sampled review, not a real-time watch: inspected 16 evenly spaced frames including first/last, all four full PNG/state pairs, ffprobe metadata and the source tape. The 19.866667-second video visibly types bare jk, shows No working copy, quits, types jk -R default, and verifies recovered log/status/workspace identity. Two-to-three-second holds make both the failure and workaround readable. Setup and assertions are hidden; brief clean shell prompts are intentional command entry, not setup leakage. The narrative preserves the failure and does not disguise it as working automatic resolution.
